label: unit or subsidiary of
definition: The first organization is an owned subsidiary, division, or organizational unit of the second.
scope_notes: The dominant part/unit/owned-by paths jointly specify organizational containment in the subsidiary-to-parent direction, as in the earlier audit. An acquisition offer alone is insufficient; mere collaboration is excluded.

facts.reason: Goodby is explicitly a part/unit of Omnicom and owned by it; the agency attachment agrees with that organizational direction.
American is called owned by and a unit of AMR, with the parent paraphrase agreeing.
Kraft General Foods is explicitly a unit of Philip Morris Cos.
Foote is explicitly owned by True North Communications.
Ogilvy & Mather is a unit/division and part of WPP Group in multiple direct paraphrases.
